**Analyzing geometry**

It seems like I'm working with an open head shape. The image shows an open head at z+10 and a U slot. The cylinder radius is probably 10, which links to the inner semicircular base of the U slot. The open-ended slot has a semicylinder at the bottom, with the radius of 10 centered at z10, and it spans the full y dimension. The outer head has a face radius of 14.92.
